summary: Reproduced and fix confirmed. At the fix parent 3a7b4895e45b (also the latest affected commit), convert.py's main loaded the fully disabled block model.layers.1, saved its empty tensor dictionary to qtensors/model.layers.1.safetensors without error, then raised ZeroDivisionError at exllamav3/conversion/convert_model.py:322 (final_bpw = num_bits / module.weights_numel()), before the forward pass that advances calibration state. At the fix 3d51a39d1338 the same script printed 'model.layers.1 ... no_weights' for that block and conversion finished, writing model.safetensors, config.json and quantization_config.json.
what_ran: No small public DeciLM/Nemotron-NAS checkpoint with a fully no_op block exists, so the repro generates a tiny random 3-layer DeciLMForCausalLM checkpoint with layer 1 fully disabled, as the cohere-qk-normalization result did for its architecture. repro.py builds a tiny random DeciLMForCausalLM checkpoint (hidden 256, 4 heads, n_heads_in_group 1, ffn_mult 3.0, 3 layers, layer 1 with attention.no_op and ffn.no_op) with Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct tokenizer files, then calls exllamav3.conversion.convert_model parser/prepare/main (the code convert.py runs) with -b 4 -cr 4 -cc 256 -d 0, in-process on physical GPU 1.
limits: Random weights and a synthetic config, not a real Nemotron Ultra or Super checkpoint; the disabled block is at index 1, not 9. Only the fix parent and fix were run; the introducing commit 75c7366bb2e2 was not. Tiny calibration (4 rows x 256 columns). One GPU (RTX 3090). Loading or memory problems specific to real Ultra-size checkpoints were not exercised.

model.repo_id: synthetic tiny DeciLMForCausalLM generated by repro.py (tokenizer from Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct)
